nodes.description: Public constant bytes32 role identifier keccak256("SNAPSHOT_ROLE") used to gate the snapshot() function.
Private mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) storing role members and adminRole used by hasRole/_grantRole.
Counters.Counter holding the monotonically increasing current snapshot id.
Constructor: mints initialSupply to msg.sender and sets DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for msg.sender.
Public function; requires SNAPSHOT_ROLE for msg.sender then calls internal _snapshot().
Internal function that increments _currentSnapshotId, emits Snapshot and returns the new id.
Internal function writing _roles[role].members[account] = true and emitting RoleGranted.
Internal function that grants a role without permission checks; only safe in constructor.
Internal mint: increases _totalSupply and _balances[account]; hook call to _beforeTokenTransfer/afterTokenTransfer.
Caller-controlled address used in the constructor (mint/setupRole) and in snapshot() role checks.
require(hasRole(SNAPSHOT_ROLE, msg.sender)) access-control gate inside snapshot(); reverts if caller lacks role.
_currentSnapshotId.increment() unchecked counter update plus Snapshot event emission inside _snapshot().
Constructor parameter defining the total amount of tokens minted to msg.sender.
Local variable holding the current snapshot id returned by _getCurrentSnapshotId().

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed to _mint and _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, ...) inside the constructor, granting the deployer admin rights.
Constructor invokes _mint(msg.sender, initialSupply), which performs _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount.
initialSupply flows into _mint and is added to total supply and balance, a supply-value dependent arithmetic path.
Constructor calls _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), an unchecked role grant.
_setupRole forwards to _grantRole, which writes the role membership without permission checks.
_grantRole writes _roles[role].members[account] = true, mutating the privileged state mapping.
msg.sender is supplied as the account argument of hasRole inside snapshot(), so the caller controls access evaluation.
snapshot() passes the SNAPSHOT_ROLE constant as the required role in the authorization check.
snapshot() calls hasRole(SNAPSHOT_ROLE, msg.sender) through the require guard.
hasRole reads _roles[role].members[account] to decide whether the caller is authorized.
Execution of snapshot() reaches the require(hasRole(...)) guard that protects the state-changing snapshot creation.
Only if the role check passes does snapshot() continue to create the snapshot.
snapshot() delegates to the internal _snapshot() implementation after the access check.
The counter increment writes the _currentSnapshotId state variable.
_snapshot() reads the counters state via _getCurrentSnapshotId() to derive the emitted/returned id.
_snapshot() assigns the retrieved counter value to the local currentId and returns it.

normalization_plan.reason: initialSupply is a constructor parameter used only as the amount argument of ERC20._mint; it normalizes into the _mint supply arithmetic.
currentId is a transient local of ERC20Snapshot._snapshot used only to return the incremented counter value; it normalizes into _snapshot.
